title: SUPER CUP ATTP – Spring 2024: Stage I
excerpt: Results of the first stage of SUPER CUP ATTP – Spring 2024
body_html:
From 24 to 26 May 2024, the National Sports Association ATTP Moldova, in partnership with Top Cup Academy and SETKA-Pro, is holding the national table tennis tournament 🏓 Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024 — an important, spectacular competition in the Republic of Moldova that brings together the best players and the most loyal table tennis amateurs from across the country🇲🇩.

Every registered participant will compete for medals, exclusive diplomas and valuable gifts.

The matches can be watched on Top Cup Academy’s Facebook page and (as replays) on Top Cup Academy’s YouTube channel.

After the first stage of the tournament, in which more than 100 seniors met, placed in 5 groups (A-E) according to the ATTP ranking, the podium places went as follows:

Group A
🥇1st place – Ruslan PAȘCHEVICI (Tiraspol)
🥈2nd place – Ilie SULIMA (Chișinău)
🥉3rd place – Igor BOBEICO (Chișinău)

Group B
🥇1st place – Oleg MEDÎNSCHI (Rîbnița)
🥈2nd place – Ion NUCA (Chișinău)
🥉3rd place – Mihail DONOAGĂ (Strășeni)

Group C
🥇1st place – Serghei SINCHIN (Chișinău)
🥈2nd place – Eugen TANASE (Chișinău)
🥉3rd place – Oleg BUCOS (Hâncești)
